scope: Mechanical screening, not certification of a fold or a repeat annotation

controls.failure: B-factor and pLDDT confused, or inconsistent local confidence metadata
controls.criterion: Experimental method, AFDB AlphaFold monomer metadata, or explicit local ColabFold monomer hash/sequence/score contract; values in domain; B/local agreement within 0.011

controls.failure: Crystallographic low-B filter applied to pLDDT
controls.criterion: Requested scale equals observed scale; pLDDT retains >= threshold; experimental B retains <= threshold; never silently filter

controls.failure: Relative unit orientation inferred from local confidence alone
controls.criterion: AFDB API binding or explicit local ColabFold contract with original score/PAE hashes and identical matrices; full sequence and unambiguous monomer axes agree; both directed interunit blocks <= declared angstrom threshold

controls.failure: Join of label_seq_id, auth_seq_id or model positions by numeric offset
controls.criterion: Explicit selected model/chain atom-site correspondence; unique requested residues and unique label/auth/insertion tuples; no inferred UniProt offset

controls.failure: Engineering construct or purification tag mistaken for native repeat
controls.criterion: Report synthetic-source/sequence-difference metadata; selected terminal poly-His motif triggers review, never automatic trimming; other engineering signals remain non-evaluable
Not evaluable from a protein coordinate file alone; requires genomic assembly, reads and independently checked annotation

controls.failure: Disagreement between supplied and reference repeat boundaries
controls.criterion: Same byte identity, chain and frame; compare all interval endpoints with declared tolerance; reference origin is declared, not authenticated

controls.failure: Silent loss or duplicate assignment of requested residues
controls.criterion: Every requested residue has exactly one finite CA observation; every unit is nonempty and units do not overlap

controls.failure: Confident but implausible repeat fold (Pratt et al.)
controls.criterion: pLDDT/PAE alone do not evaluate physical validity. The optional operator-configured development profile1.1 measures exposure of polar ionizable groups with two probes (8% at1.4Å and2% at2Å); these are engineering hypotheses, not validated fold-failure thresholds. It can warn of buried nominal-charge columns or distributed severe packing conflicts. A pass means neither targeted warning was detected; global fold validity and stability remain not established. Independent physical/experimental evidence and separate evaluation remain required.
